changes: Added a full Reforge upgrade path for Whispering Woods gear: every Vanguard/Adept piece can now be reforged common -> uncommon -> rare -> epic -> legendary from the Inventory page, each tier gated behind reaching a deeper part of the zone and costing materials plus Focus.
Legendary gear can also now drop directly from bosses deep in a zone.
Gear leveling from duplicates now caps per rarity, so grinding one common item can no longer out-power reforging into a higher tier.
Prestige is reorganized into separate Recall and Ascend tabs, and stays hidden from the main navigation until you're actually close to unlocking it.
The Guide page now only shows articles relevant to your progress (e.g. Gear and Crafting stay hidden until you've found your first item).
Training and Abilities now use direct ×1/×5/×10/×25/Max buy buttons instead of a separate quantity toggle.

Reworked several pages (Guide, Settings, Prestige, Training, Abilities, Inventory) to use the full width of the screen instead of a narrow centered column, and fixed Inventory action buttons overlapping on smaller cards.
Added new prestige perks, including Keen Edge, Heavy Hitter, and Vampiric Touch.
Fixed fast, cheap abilities starving slower ones of Stamina and Mana, and doubled base Stamina/Mana caps.
Fixed several abilities not counting toward their own usage statistics.
The combat log now collapses repeated hits into a single running line instead of flooding out other events.
Recall's permanent stat-gain bonus now scales with the deepest depth you've ever Recalled at, closing an exploit where recalling shallowly on repeat out-paced genuine progress.
Ascend's permanent stat-gain bonus now scales with your biggest single Ascend payout for the same reason.

Added a compounding Boss Power bonus so your damage keeps pace with monster scaling at extreme depth, and zones now unlock after clearing a set number of that zone's bosses rather than requiring a full depth clear.
Fixed a rare crash and performance issue when Overkill chained through many kills at once.
Added the Speed stat, player HP, and monster counter-attacks on their own real-time timer.
Replaced the ability priority list with independent per-ability cooldowns; Active mode manual clicks now deal bonus damage.
Replaced random gear rolls with a curated item catalog, gear sets with set bonuses, and duplicate items now auto-fuse into levels instead of cluttering your inventory.
Added gear comparison, augment descriptions, a gear stats overview, and item salvage to the Inventory page.
Reworked the UI into full-page tabs with a new HUD header and dark fantasy theme.
Initial release: Stamina/Mana/Focus resources, Whispering Woods zone, basic combat, gear, augments, and Recall/Ascend prestige.
